title: gymnocalycium anisitsii subsp. multiproliferum
intro: Gymnocalycium anisitsii subsp. multiproliferum, commonly known as the many-headed or multiproliferous living rock, is a cactus species that belongs to the Echinocactaceae family. This plant is known for its unique ability to produce numerous stems, which gives it its characteristic appearance. Gymnocalycium anisitsii subsp. multiproliferum has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, wounds, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its multiple health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
